scope: Restricted private speaker pilot; no production identity promotion or incumbent deletion
incumbent: Frozen production registry and observed source diarization; replay incumbent name matcher twice
candidate: Interval recovery plus one explicitly allowed new multi-recording voice profile

fixed_set.selection: First two completed SMART/FMDS recordings on or after cutoff; fixed admissions cannot rotate

default_verdict: KEEP incumbent while human truth, scale, or any other gate is incomplete
recanary: Resolve named blockers and rerun the identical frozen source/profile set twice per arm
